# Yamoto Wheel & Tyre Care

> Wheel and tyre shop in Kondapur, Hyderabad, Telangana, India (near Kothaguda Junction). Computerised wheel alignment, wheel balancing, nitrogen filling, tyre rotation and new car & SUV tyres. Walk-ins welcome; most jobs done while you wait.

## Services
- Wheel alignment (about 40 min): computerised camber, caster and toe set to factory spec, with a before/after readout.
- Wheel balancing (about 30 min): dynamic balancing on all four wheels, alloy-safe weights.
- Nitrogen filling (about 10 min): fill, top-ups, pressure and valve check.
- Tyre rotation (about 25 min): front-to-back / cross rotation with tread-depth check.
- New tyres: MRF, Apollo, CEAT, Bridgestone, Michelin, JK Tyre, Yokohama, Goodyear — fitted, balanced and aligned in the same visit.

## Visit
- Area: Kondapur, Hyderabad. Also serves Gachibowli, Madhapur, Hitech City, Hafeezpet, Miyapur, Serilingampally.
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM – 8:30 PM; Sunday 9:30 AM – 2:00 PM.
- Book or get a price on WhatsApp, by phone, or with the quote form at https://www.yamoto.com
